name: Ron Gastrobar
dinnerNote: À la carte; mains €25–€47 (Beef Wellington €90 for two)
dinnerNoteNl: À la carte; hoofdgerechten € 25–47 (Beef Wellington € 90 voor twee)

menus.name: Sunday Well Spent menu
menus.note: Sunday afternoons only: a snack, a starter and the Beef Wellington with mashed potato and gravy; for 2 or more people, in multiples of two.

bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's booking page (Zenchef), with a €15 per person prepayment, or by phone. Open every day from 12pm to 10.30pm for lunch and dinner.
cancellation: Bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours ahead and changed up to 2 hours ahead. The restaurant sends a confirmation email and a reminder and calls on the day.
groups: Online bookings are for up to 8 people. For groups of more than 8, events or private parties, use the group request form.
children: Children are welcome, but there is no children's menu.
